digest.component_or_area: IAM policy and Bedrock service integration
propositions: The review-bot container requires Bedrock credentials through the instance role to invoke Claude models via pydantic-ai's BedrockProvider, which calls the Converse API and authorizes against bedrock:InvokeModel (not bedrock:Converse)

The IAM grant must be scoped to Claude foundation models and cross-region inference profiles with wildcarded regions, using bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream actions on the appropriate ARN patterns
IMDS is reachable from the review-bot container (token PUT succeeds, role resolves), so the solution is IAM-only; hop-limit contingency applies only if AC1 shows IMDS unreachable
The policy must be added as a new scoped inline policy in infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf following the single-owner contract pattern (iam_s2.tf / iam_s4a.tf), leaving iam.tf unmodified

Runtime verification requires a real Converse call from the instance (not simulator results alone, which cannot reveal which action the service actually checks) and a negative control against a non-Claude model to prove scope binding
